name: pc-1-limit
check: grep -q '/ 4 > 50000 or not job.get' tools/qwen/pipeline.py && ! grep -q '/ 4 > 13000' tools/qwen/pipeline.py && python3 -m unittest tools/qwen/test_check_loop.py tools/qwen/test_reachable.py && test $(git diff --stat tools/qwen/pipeline.py | grep -c changed) -eq 1 && test $(git diff --numstat tools/qwen/pipeline.py | cut -f1) -le 3

name: pc-2-comment
check: grep -q 'the queue refuses more' tools/qwen/pipeline.py && ! grep -q 'cuts prompts at ~8k' tools/qwen/pipeline.py && python3 -m unittest tools/qwen/test_check_loop.py tools/qwen/test_reachable.py
